transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we all know, Paint Booth 4 was stopped this morning after solvent was found pooled beneath its circulation manifold. The booth is currently isolated and the spill area is cordoned off. Before I can make any decisions on containment, restart authorization, or the recovery plan, I need to hear findings from maintenance, environmental compliance, production, and quality — per our standard incident-review practice. Let's start with maintenance. Can you walk us through what you've found so far?

transcript.text: Elena, from an environmental compliance standpoint, I need to flag that my measured cleanup estimate is exactly 240 liters of solvent-contaminated liquid. Because that volume exceeds the plant's hazardous-waste threshold, it requires a licensed hauler and a hazardous-waste manifest. I confirmed the threshold with our waste contractor today, but I have not yet entered the estimate in the waste log — I'll do that immediately after this call.
